tagline: Search every application route — and tag the assets on it.
problem: navi groups findings into application routes, and that is where exposure concentrates by app. Pulling one app's routes — and tagging the assets on them — shouldn't need a hand-written query.
does: Explorer › Routes searches the application routes in navi.db by app name or vulnerability type, with each route's total findings and plugins. Tag applies Route : <name> to every asset on that route.

glance.caption: Explorer › Routes's results: each route's app, type, total findings and plugins, with a Tag button per route.

capabilities: by app name or vulnerability type.
total findings and the plugins behind each route.
Route : <name> on every asset on that route, with an editable value, behind the write gate and a confirm.
send the rows through Notify & Report.
how: Explorer › Routes reads the application routes in your local navi.db without changing it; results page on the server, 20 rows a page (up to 50). Tags go through navi's tag command.
who: Analysts scoping an application's exposure and owners looking up their app.
better: Exposure Routes assigns owners to these routes, Custom App Discovery names the custom apps among them, and Explorer › Paths does the same for filesystem paths.
cta: Pull an app's routes with Explorer › Routes — and tag them in one step.
